seo.title: Tarawa homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Tarawa.

page.heading: TARAWA - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Police emergency: 192. Ambulance: 194. Domestic violence: 188. Women and children 24-hour helpline: 189. Social Welfare emergency cases: 1113.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: No general homelessness shelter is publicly listed for Tarawa. For an unsafe home or violence, call the Kiribati Women and Children Support Centre. For other urgent welfare needs, call Social Welfare on 1113; the service may refer or assess help but accommodation is not guaranteed.
page.footer: Main sources: Kiribati Ministry of Women Youth and Social Affairs, Kiribati Women and Children Support Centre, Tungaru Central Hospital, Kiribati Red Cross and the listed referral services.

entries.title: Social Welfare Division emergency cases
entries.description: Government social-welfare contact for urgent family and protection cases.
entries.how_to_access: Call 1113 and explain the immediate need.

entries.title: Kiribati Women and Children Support Centre
entries.description: Confidential support, counselling and referrals for women and children affected by sexual or gender-based violence.
entries.how_to_access: Call 189. Use Police 192 if there is immediate danger.

entries.title: Kiribati Red Cross Society
entries.description: Humanitarian and disaster assistance through the national society. Assistance depends on assessed need and current programmes.
entries.how_to_access: Contact the society and explain the situation. It is not a guaranteed daily shelter service.

entries.title: Tungaru Central Hospital
entries.description: Main public referral hospital in Tarawa. Ambulance can be reached on 194.
entries.how_to_access: Attend for urgent care or call ambulance 194.

entries.title: Kiribati Family Health Association
entries.description: Sexual and reproductive health information, counselling and referral. The organisation helped establish the Kiribati Women and Children Support Centre.
entries.how_to_access: Contact the association for clinic and counselling availability.

entries.title: Kiribati Women and Children Support Centre
entries.description: Support for women and children affected by domestic or sexual violence, including counselling, legal information and referrals.
entries.how_to_access: Call 189 or visit the centre when safe. Police emergency is 192.

entries.title: Domestic violence response
entries.description: National domestic-violence contact published in the Tarawa support directory.
entries.how_to_access: Call 188. If immediate police help is needed, call 192.
